name: How do I know if my bathroom needs a complete remodel rather than minor repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my bathroom needs a complete remodel rather than minor repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs that your bathroom needs a full renovation include persistent moisture problems, loose or cracked tile, recurring plumbing leaks, and fixtures that no longer function properly. You may also need a remodel if the layout feels cramped, lacks adequate storage, or presents safety risks such as high tub walls for household members with limited mobility. Surface repairs and paint can fix small cosmetic flaws, but underlying water damage, soft subflooring, or failing drywall often require full tear-outs to rebuild walls and waterproof layers correctly. A full renovation addresses both visible style and hidden structural durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need a full remodel when facing persistent leaks, compromised drywall or subflooring, broken tile, outdated plumbing, or a layout that no longer suits your mobility needs.
